description: Implementation of the WindowManager class for HTTP/2 window size management, including functions for updating window limits, buffering, flushing, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: WindowManager
classes.description: Manages flow control window size, buffering, and listener notifications for HTTP/2 streams.

methods.name: DefaultShouldWindowUpdateFn
methods.description: Determines whether to send a window update based on current limits and delta.

methods.name: WindowManager::OnWindowSizeLimitChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the window size limit.

methods.name: WindowManager::SetWindowSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets a new window size limit and potentially notifies the listener.

methods.name: WindowManager::MarkDataBuffered
methods.description: Marks data as buffered and updates window state accordingly.

methods.name: WindowManager::MarkDataFlushed
methods.description: Marks data as flushed and updates buffer state.

methods.name: WindowManager::MaybeNotifyListener
methods.description: Decides whether to notify the listener based on current window state.
